title: Recipe
description: A production recipe: inputs to outputs over a cycle. The building supplies the workforce. One file per recipe in content/recipes/<id>.json.

inputs.description: Goods consumed per cycle; leave out for gatherers.

outputs.description: Goods produced per cycle; at least one.

cycleSeconds.description: Game seconds per cycle at 100% productivity.

start.description: Only needed for a recipe that no building names in its recipe field: available from the start without an unlockRecipe effect. A recipe that a building names is available with that building.
